notes.content:
CUSTOMIZER CONTEST HIGHLIGHTS

After a long hiatus, the bioroid customizer contest is back in swing, with a new winner Cayelo. First place went to the handler's namesake Cayelo, while returning player tomiroid's beret SgtMallory and scary clown IT took the rest of the podium spots. Congrats to the winners!

The race has begun once again! Be sure to share your submissions on social media to collect as many votes as possible and to win a 3D print of your own bioroid!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/d0db2898ff50ab9a36238be9279b2456c728a1f2.png


FAILED CHALLENGES AND EMOTES

We are close to 1000 animations for Herogrinder, related to the multitudes of actions and their consequences. The following samples are related to failing actions like opening a door or repositioning a cover, as well as some emotes to spice things up!

[previewyoutube=Y2m7xYbOD10;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=2iulHaJU3n0;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=ADK-NG-EDXk;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=Cf9-ZHoT_D8;full][/previewyoutube]


GRAFFITI IN HG ARENAS

To immerse players in the arenas of New Horizon Media, special emphasis is placed on designing wall decorations like graffiti or ads, that bring the street and cyberpunk to the game. Walls and objects are also destructible, in different stages of degradation, so the art on the wall needs to align and follow these changes. The following samples beautifully demonstrate what the developers and artists have in mind.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/17fe5b23da2f5c2be030cbcf3eee66f3db5d7c24.png
[previewyoutube=eQ5fga7YjcI;full][/previewyoutube]


EXTRA LARGE ARENA OBJECTS

Arenas looked quite empty and two-dimensional so to give them depth, we have decided to add vertical above-ground and underground elements. These include a monorail system, subway entries, sewers, or bridges. These assets bring height and a sense of space to the game.

Update: Adrenaline Serum #56BX recall

OUR MAP EDITOR TOOL

We did some shader experiments recently to find out how to achieve more variations to our environmental assets without changing or duplicating their diffuse textures. In the Bioroid Customizer, we use a different approach to color the bioroid parts, but to do the same with the environment assets in our Map Editor, hundreds of textures would need to be converted to masks which we'd like to avoid. Our 3D Artists often use one or two clean colors in the textures, so the idea is to sample and recolor those tones on the fly in the shader. It still needs some polishing, but the results are promising!

[previewyoutube=ltldxAilN4w;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=Q0crvAnk3Vk;full][/previewyoutube]

NHM NEWSFLASH: TECHNOLOGY 2489.10.08.

Carlton's Nanny A.I.s on the rise

More and more parents are using the "Nanny A.I." developed by Carlton Applied Cybernetics. Implanted into the child's neural interface at an early age, the A.I. not only monitors, but mentors and teaches the little ones, forming a special bond with the child through the years. Main concerns are that children with the program tend to distance themselves from their parents in the process and develop deficiencies in social interactions. Martin Flynn, the company's Head of R&D assures parents that "The A.I. knows the subject more than its genitors, so it is naturally the best equipped to raise it to adulthood."

NHM NEWSFLASH: TECHNOLOGY 2489.09.04.

MediCore challenges ban on human testing for MedPods

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/ee3e125f4b3fe5fefc05e181baad4491f577867d.jpg

MediCore Pharmaceuticals has challenged the prohibition on human testing for their restorative technologies at the International Courts in Cairo. MediCore currently provides bioroid clones and regenerative MedPods to the Herogrinder gameshow. The current law blocks the use of MediCore's technologies from public use, lacking human trials. “At MediCore, we value life above all else! MedPods allow our bioroids to get back to combat straight away without loss of valuable biomatter and the contestant’s time. Currently MedPods are configured to bioroids and human research has been prohibited. This has got to change.” said Kassy Lucetta, CEO of MediCore.

HEROGRINDER DESIGN: THE LAB
Our goal is to feature as many types of arenas and styles in our level designs as possible to create great variety. We are designing 3D models of all our assets - walls, tiles, and objects. All assets can be damaged and destroyed, used as cover, most can be moved around and some can be switched on and off for an effect. The objective was to create objects that not only fit into the cyberpunk aesthetic of the game but offer a tactical element as well.

HEROGRINDER EVOLUTIONS: RAYCASTER
To follow-up from our Herogrinder: Evolutions post a few months ago, we've decided to put the Raycaster into focus to showcase the full involvement of our entire team in the creation of a beautiful game asset. The Raycaster is a great example of the creative process behind Herogrinder, especially the game designers since it is a unique weapon that adds new game mechanics.

Instead of standard ammo and line of sight firing, the Raycaster emits an area effect that can target multiple enemies at the same time in either a line or a cone. The weapon is basically a point-and-fire solution that never misses and doesn't require an attack roll. As an energy weapon, it also negates recoil and can't fumble either. In addition, it also causes burn damage in succeeding rounds if the enemy can't avoid the flames.

Based on these specifications from game designers, our concept artist Luke drew the gun and we finalized the concept together. Then our 3D artist Gergo designed the object in 3D. Finally, our Unity team integrated it into the game environment and added it to the customizer.

We came full circle when the content team created the lore around the weapon and placed it into the context of the game, like so:

"The Widerange Raycaster is the pride of Stellar Dynamics in the newest line from the “Spectrum series” developed in orbital factories under zero-g manufacturing protocols. Laser emissions are spread in a wide cone or straight line shape for area effects that will hit all your enemies at once and set them on fire with a single blast."

DEV UPDATE: MAP EDITOR TOOL
Developments for Herogrinder are going strong and while we are continuously working on preparing new character assets like armors, weapons, hairstyles and so on, we are also focusing on developing the game itself. Our main project this month was streamlining and populating our map editor tool, which allows us to model arenas in 3D. We have implemented almost 1000 assets into the tool and have categorized them (walls/doors, floor tiles, terrain objects, light sources, and designs like small objects, decals, and particle effects) to create the file architecture for all visual environmental elements of Herogrinder.

Our next main task is to turn the editor tool into a testing environment for characters and animations, basically to see the finished product in the game environment. With a few editor scripts, we are now able to see the working models and animations that our 3D design team creates and finalize them with the involvement of our entire studio. And all through our editor tool.
